title: Ship schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json in every hyvv install artifact

outcome.summary: The runtime ticket schema C2 reads is carried by every hyvv installation path. The sdist include list and the wheel force-include map both name schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json at the path launcher.py resolves it from, the Windows $payload copies the schemas directory so a fresh install and an -Update both keep it, and install.sh fails closed when the installed launcher cannot load it. No product code changes: launcher.py, the schema and the C2 test surface are untouched, and the existing provisioning/Rails payload stays green.
observable_behavior: A wheel built from this tree contains schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json at the wheel root, so `import launcher; launcher._ticket_schema()` succeeds from an extracted wheel with the checkout absent and returns a schema titled rizzstack.ticket/1.
A materialised copy of install.ps1's $payload contains schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json beside launcher.py and the launcher loads it from that root, not from the checkout.
The sdist include list names the schemas directory (or the schema file) so the source distribution can build the same payload.
install.sh's post-install probe loads the ticket schema from the installed venv and exits 1 with an explicit message when it cannot, instead of leaving a launcher that fails at request time.
The existing payload guarantees are unchanged: tests/test_install_artifacts.py still passes, including its real-artifact identity checks when uv is available.

interfaces.name: pyproject.toml [tool.hatch.build.targets.sdist].include
interfaces.notes: Adds schemas/** so the sdist carries the runtime schema at schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json.

interfaces.name: pyproject.toml [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include]
interfaces.notes: Maps schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json to schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json so it lands at the site-packages root LAUNCHER_DIR resolves against.

interfaces.name: scripts/install.ps1 $payload
interfaces.notes: Adds the schemas directory; Copy-Payload already recurses into directory entries.

interfaces.name: scripts/install.sh post-install probe
interfaces.notes: Adds a fail-closed `import launcher; launcher._ticket_schema()` probe after the existing module-import probe.

interfaces.name: tests/test_ticket_schema_payload.py
interfaces.notes: Approved RED specification; read-only for the implementer.

acceptance_criteria.statement: the sdist include list names the schemas directory or the runtime schema file, so a source distribution can carry it
the wheel force-include maps schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json to the same path, which is where launcher.py resolves it after installation
install.ps1's payload names the schemas directory and a materialised copy of that payload contains the schema beside launcher.py, from which the launcher loads it
install.sh probes the installed launcher's ticket-schema load and fails closed with exit 1 instead of installing a runtime that raises at request time
regression: the existing provisioning and Rails payload guarantees still hold (tests/test_install_artifacts.py green, unchanged)

dependencies: C2 (hyvv #83) at head 708df906e6b9402c537fb51f7ea42c183dc35aad supplies schemas/rizzstack-ticket.schema.json and launcher._ticket_schema(); this slice is cut from that head
C2's frozen lease prohibits pyproject.toml, uv.lock and CHANGELOG.md, so the packaging change is a follow-up slice, not an amendment
#83 merges only after this slice is approved and verified; both land before the hyvv deploy
assumptions: hatchling's force-include places entries at the wheel root, so LAUNCHER_DIR / 'schemas' / 'rizzstack-ticket.schema.json' resolves inside site-packages
install.ps1 Copy-Payload already recurses into directory payload entries, so a 'schemas' entry needs no new copy code
the uv-built-wheel class skips when no build tool is installed; the declaration and copied-payload classes run everywhere

authorized: edit the three packaging/installer files inside the declared scope
build a wheel and sdist locally as test output

reasons: changes what every hyvv install artifact ships (wheel, sdist, Windows payload) and how install.sh decides an install is complete
a wrong force-include path installs a launcher that fails at request time instead of at install time
the installer probe can refuse an otherwise healthy install if it is written too broadly
risk.blast_radius: every hyvv wheel, sdist, install.sh run and install.ps1 fresh/Update copy
